correctness.rationale: For every complex coefficient, rotation reduces to t=|a|; the critical coanalytic Bergman-kernel expansion gives a cubic interior-root matching matrix. The one-root condition is t=-4α², and two companion roots have exact moduli ((√13±1)/4)√t, yielding the sharp interval ((14+2√13)/9,4). The two-root determinant and Vieta force an interior-root modulus exceeding the unique exterior-root modulus, contradiction; repeated interior roots give nonzero confluent determinant 19t/4; three inside roots are excluded by numerator degree and the f(0)=0 normalization, including λ=0. Zero roots cannot give a kernel; the Fredholm index-zero and essential-curve premises are attributed to the cited literature. A standalone SymPy program checked determinant and factorization identities and six parameter samples; finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exceptional spectrum of nonnormal harmonic-Bergman Toeplitz operators is an established meaningful invariant. The recent general degree-three theorem permits up to eight exceptional points but does not specify the sharp phase boundary. Determining exactly zero or two nonessential spectral points and both algebraic radical thresholds gives a natural complete one-parameter classification, exhibiting actual disconnectedness transitions rather than an arbitrary numerical sample.
